papers.title: UlaCache: Unified Logical Addressing for Sparse LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Long contexts increase the memory cost of the key-value (KV) cache in large language model (LLM) inference. Sparse attention reduces attention computation and memory traffic by selecting historical tokens, but the retained KV cache must remain available for later decoding steps. papers.abstract: Request migration and interruption recovery in distributed large language model (LLM) inference rely on historical key-value (KV) caches. papers.abstract: Decision models return probabilities over supplied options, but a deployed agent may also need to reply in words. Existing methods score each candidate for deletion on its own, with the rest of the cache being held fixed. papers.relevance_zh: 与边缘AI部署和联邦学习相关，创新点在于通过稀疏化技术提升了模型在边缘设备上的适用性。
papers.summary_zh:
问题：这篇论文关注在资源受限环境中，如何高效处理时间序列数据的分类问题。
方法：提出了一种稀疏的联邦回声状态网络，通过平滑L1正则化提高了模型的计算效率和存储效率。
相关性：与边缘AI部署和联邦学习相关，创新点在于通过稀疏化技术提升了模型在边缘设备上的适用性。
